{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check channel values
print(f"Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")

# Check revenue dtype
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")

# Show first few rows of revenue
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")"}
